exams.name: Certificate of Qualification Examination
exams.notes: Exam covers general business knowledge, rules and regulations, and the Construction Industries Licensing Act. Applicants for GB, MM or EE classification also take a technical knowledge test. Alternatively, applicants may satisfy the business and law portion by completing an approved business and law course.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by the Construction Industries Division)
exams.quote: no certificate of qualification shall be issued to an individual desiring to be a qualifying party until he has passed with a satisfactory score an examination approved and adopted by the division

interval_years.quote: Contractor's licenses shall expire two years after the issuance date or as determined by the division, but in no instance less than one year, and shall be renewable upon application to the division and payment of the prescribed renewal fee

required.quote: Licensees and journeyman certificate holders may be required to complete and submit proof of continuing education as a prerequisite for renewal of a license. When required by rule adopted by the division, an applicant for a license renewal must submit with the application for license renewal proof of eight hours of instruction in code change and eight hours of instruction in other industry-related and division-approved subjects.
